name: Spectral Melee
description: Spectral Melee allows you to focus the ghostly powers to defeat your foes. Your foes cower in fear from repeated exposure to your attacks, striking a fully feared target manifests a haunting spirit to assist you for a short time.

powers.name: Haunting Strike
powers.description: You gather spectral energy in your hands and lash out at a target's spirit, dealing minor damage and possibly striking fear into the hearts of your victims. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Haunting Blow
powers.description: A ruthless strike of spectral energy to a foe's spirit, dealing moderate damage, and inflicting fear on your foe. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Gripping Terror
powers.description: You unleash a wave of spectral teror upon your targets, dealing Negative energy damage as restless spirits immobilize and fear affected foes. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Moderate
powers.shortHelp: Melee (Cone), Moderate DMG(Negative/Psionic), Foe Immobilize, Fear

powers.name: Assassin's Reave
powers.description: A signature Stalker attack.  This attack does superior Negative and Psychic damage on its own as a frontal attack and cannot be interrupted.  However, if it is executed while you are Hidden, this attack will do tremendous damage, as you waylay your unsuspecting foe. This attack may be interrupted if you move or are attacked while executing this power and are hidden.  Using this power while not hidden has a chance to critically hit equal to 33.3% times the number of stacks of Assassin's Focus. Using Assassin's Strike when not hidden will remove all stacks of Assassin's Focus regardless if you critically hit or not.  Damage: Special, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Build Up
powers.description: Greatly increases the amount of damage you deal for a few seconds, as well as slightly increasing your chance to hit.  Recharge: Long

powers.name: Possess
powers.description: You cause your targeted foe to be possessed by a dark entity from the Netherworld causing them to be confused for a short period of time. While confused they will be unable to tell the difference between friend or foe and will attack nearby allies. Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Encroaching Nightmare
powers.description: You release a burst of spectral energy to foes around you, dealing moderate Negative energy damage as spirits immobilize and fear affected foes. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Long

powers.name: Nightmarish Grasp
powers.description: You unleash ravenous spirits upon your foe, dealing negative energy damage as the spirits immobilize and fear them.  Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate
powers.shortHelp: Ranged, High DMG(Negative/Psionic), Foe Immobilize, Fear

powers.name: Spirit Sunder
powers.description: You Sunder the spirit from one of your foes to create a life transferring conduit between them and yourself. This will transfer Hit Points from your enemy to yourself. Foes Siphoned in this manner will summon a spectral essence to do your bidding. the spirit is only loosely bound to your control and will eventually move on to the next world.  Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Slow
powers.shortHelp: Melee, Extreme DMG(Negative/Psionic), Foe Fear, Self +HP, Summon Spirits
